scenarios.name: model_compatible
scenarios.description: Exact conditional NB2 log-mean model in source build_X; fixed beta per design, with true mu and mu_cf generated from beta.

scenarios.name: response_misspecification
scenarios.description: Source nonlinear threshold response truth fit by the shared three-knot lag spline model; no additional omitted U term.

scenarios.name: omitted_confounding
scenarios.description: Source misspec=True DGP: omitted time-varying U correlated with exposure contributes to the outcome mean and is held fixed under the counterfactual.

design.counterfactual: Use the fixed true counterfactual xcf_lag from the pinned source design for both the estimator and truth; bias=0. This isolates outcome-resampling uncertainty from estimated-Delta error.
design.positive_control_beta: Per design and country, project log(source mu/pop) on source build_X by least squares, then regenerate fixed mu and mu_cf exactly from X beta and X_cf beta. Save beta and projection diagnostics.
design.truth: For each fixed panel, A_true = sum(mu - mu_cf) over all regions and months; the same stored value is used for every outcome resample.
design.outcome_resampling: For each replication, draw Y independently from NB2(theta, mean=fixed mu) without regenerating exposure, population, offset, knots, true coefficients, mu, or counterfactual arrays.

sampling.rep_seed_rule: NumPy SeedSequence([base_seed, mode_id, scenario_id, design_seed, stage_id, replicate_index]); pilot and formal use distinct mode_id values.
sampling.finite_sample_quantile: k=ceil((n_cal+1)*(1-alpha)); return sort(scores)[k-1] when k<=n_cal and +infinity when k>n_cal; pilot calibration n=12 gives a finite 90% order statistic.
sampling.raw_exact_t_df: min(number of region clusters, number of year clusters) - 1; for the full fit this is 9
sampling.source_t_approximation: Compare against pinned core_sim.tq(df), which uses a Cornish-Fisher approximation. Exact t critical values are primary.

methods.delta_primary: A_hat ± exact_t_0.95(df) × h_component_CR1, where h_component_CR1 uses grouped region×year intersections and component-specific group-count CR1 corrections; raw covariance is not clipped.
methods.delta_corrected_common_cr1_tw: Grouped region×year intersection meat with the same common min-cluster CR1 multiplier and eigenvalue clipping as the legacy covariance; direct comparator isolating the intersection aggregation change.
methods.delta_legacy_covariance: Same estimate and exact t quantile, but source observation-level intersection subtraction X'U^2X, common min-cluster CR1 multiplier, and source eigenvalue clipping; diagnostic only.
methods.delta_legacy_source: Pinned source legacy covariance and core_sim.tq(df) approximation; source reproduction diagnostic only.
methods.delta_independent_HC1_positive_control: Independent-observation HC1 sandwich covariance with t_(n-p) interval; contextual positive-control benchmark under conditionally independent NB2 outcome draws.
methods.delta_region_cr1_context: One-way region-cluster CR1 covariance with region-cluster t critical value; contextual benchmark only.
methods.raw_scale_calibrated: Use an independent scale-calibration set to take the finite-sample 90th percentile of |A_hat-A_true|/h_corrected; test only on disjoint outcomes. The multiplier is unconditional within the fixed panel and incorporates bias.
methods.bias_centered_split_calibrated: Estimate mean bias on the separate bias_train set (truth is available in simulation), estimate a finite-sample score quantile on the disjoint scale_calibration set after centering, then evaluate on test. This is a simulation/known-truth validation diagnostic, not deployable without a labeled external calibration target.
methods.year_split_q_diagnostic: Source-style year split-half q on the first predeclared test reps only, using 30 random 5-of-10 year splits. Each half fit estimates every coefficient on its half, then predicts the attribution over the full fixed grid using all coefficients; split covariance gradients use that same full grid. The diagnostic reuses test outcomes and has no conformal guarantee.
methods.shared_additive_shift: Synthetic estimator-only common bias: add fixed c to A_hat in bias training, scale calibration, and test while keeping A_true fixed. The truth-trained center shifts by c and centered q is algebraically invariant; the raw interval exposes the uncorrected bias. A separate equivariance identity may translate both estimate and truth for a unit check.

fit.covariance: Primary component-specific two-way CR1: corrected region meat + corrected year meat - corrected region×year grouped intersection meat; use per-component group count correction × (n-1)/(n-p). Keep raw symmetric covariance; do not eigenvalue-clip the corrected covariance.
fit.common_cr1_comparator: Use grouped region×year intersections and the same common min-cluster correction and PSD clipping policy as the source legacy covariance to isolate the intersection aggregation change.
fit.legacy_covariance: Pinned source observation-level intersection subtraction, common min-cluster correction, and eigenvalue clipping for comparison only.
fit.method_validity: Coefficient fit validity requires convergence, full design rank, and finite coefficients/estimate. Each method's interval additionally requires its own positive finite variance; failure of one covariance does not invalidate another method.
fit.failed_interval_policy: Count planned replicate as uncovered for coverage; preserve failure and convergence flags; widths are summarized only among finite valid intervals with valid_n reported.
